definition: A versioned configuration preset for Case intake, suggested organization, relevant capabilities, and review guidance. It uses the universal Case model and grants no authority.

templates.name: General research
intake: objective and questions
Seed information and its origin
time/geographic/language relevance
included and excluded subjects
source and disclosure constraints
reviewFocus: answer each question with cited support
identify copied sources and contradictions
state unresolved questions and next steps

scenario.seed: A fictional organization and two articles
scenario.awkward: The second article copies the first and another record contradicts the date

templates.name: Missing person
intake: objective and researcher relationship/authority basis
known identifiers, aliases and supplied photographs
last-known event with time zone and uncertainty
age band/vulnerability and consent constraints, including unknown
included and excluded locations/sources
approved contact or escalation reference, if any
reviewFocus: separate reported last-seen facts from collection time
review each candidate identity against its sources
retain contradictory sightings and unresolved uncertainty
record any human resolution without promising current location

scenario.seed: A fictional adult-or-unknown-age person with a supplied last-seen note
scenario.awkward: A similar username and old image metadata suggest two different people

templates.name: Criminal investigation
intake: research objective and alleged event
researcher role, jurisdiction and declared authority basis
event time range and location with uncertainty
roles asserted by supplied records and their origins
sensitive-person, witness/victim/minor handling constraints
permitted records and excluded sources
reviewFocus: preserve allegations as attributed assertions
review supporting and conflicting material equally
trace event and collection times independently
record human conclusions and outstanding limitations without a guilt score

scenario.seed: Two fictional statements and a supplied dated record
scenario.awkward: The dated record conflicts with the first allegation and a person has a similar name

templates.name: Cyber investigation
intake: objective and technical identifiers
incident/observation window and origin
asset ownership or declared authorization context
permitted third-party lookups and data disclosure
active methods and targets only for a separate proposed plan
reviewFocus: distinguish historical provider observations from current measurements
keep technical indicators separate from person attribution
label missing coverage and unresolved hypotheses
review any target-contacting plan separately

scenario.seed: A synthetic domain and IP observation
scenario.awkward: An old provider result reports an open service while another provider is unavailable

templates.name: Financial investigation
intake: objective and relevant period
organization names and official identifiers
chain/network, address or transaction references where relevant
currency/units and time precision
declared access/handling rights for supplied records
included and excluded subjects
reviewFocus: preserve chain/currency/identifier distinctions
review company-name and person matches separately
attribute provider clustering labels to the provider
record uncertainty without a criminal-intent inference

scenario.seed: Two fictional similarly named companies and a synthetic transaction
scenario.awkward: A provider labels an address cluster without evidence of a named person's ownership

templates.name: GitHub and code research
intake: research objective and repository/account identifiers
public or explicitly authorized private access
selected revision, branch or collection-time reference
paths, organizations and time ranges in scope
whether architecture, provenance, dependencies or security is being studied
reviewFocus: pin collected source references to a revision
separate forks/copies from independent origin evidence
keep code assertions distinct from deployment behavior
review sensitive snippets before export and keep external posting separate

scenario.seed: A fictional repository at commit A and a fork
scenario.awkward: The branch advances to commit B and the fork repeats the same code

templates.name: Bug bounty
intake: program/platform reference and supplied or accessible brief
versioned rules/scope Artifact and capture time
included assets, exclusions and wildcard interpretation
permitted methods, time windows and traffic limits
third-party restrictions and approved account context
objective, report destination and evidence handling constraints
reviewFocus: review scope and exclusions before any target-contacting plan
preserve tool/template/request/response versions
separate scanner assertions from accepted Findings
review reproduction, impact and report scope
keep submission as separately approved engagement

scenario.seed: A fictional program brief, one authorized synthetic asset and reviewed test proposal
scenario.awkward: The program scope changes and a redirect points to an excluded third party
